# Synthetic 0.23.0 preservation fixture

`synthetic-0.23-progress.json` contains fictional CFP, Sigma CP, Vigilon, Nano and Galaxy records for the 0.24.0 browser acceptance script. It is generated with engine modules and data extracted from committed web 0.23.0 (`b126f5b4c54709aa161416963d0cf9dde91d8d72`); the four engine SHA256 values are recorded in the fixture.

CFP/Sigma records retain the earlier labelled fixture and pass through the committed engine's restoration function. Vigilon and Nano use their own fictional normal site, one supported synthetic fault and a marked completed lesson. Galaxy retains a fictional zone name. These are synthetic stored settings, not evidence of physical work or a real panel state.

The browser also seeds an explicitly synthetic saved visit, schedule import and pack usage, together with the actual bytes of a previously checked Gent PDF. New XFP/Twinflex interactions must preserve these earlier records and PDF bytes through navigation and offline reload. Guided tasks for the new panels use separate state stores and do not replace any prior trainer record.

Browser replay is `FINDR_PLAYWRIGHT_PATH=/opt/codex/cua_node/lib/node_modules/playwright node scripts/qa-fire-service.cjs` against `FINDR_QA_URL` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8087`). It uses `/usr/bin/chromium`, or `FINDR_CHROMIUM`. Default viewport widths are 390 and 1440, both 844 high. `FINDR_QA_LAYOUT_ONLY=1` blocks service workers for preparatory checks; only the default full run writes final browser evidence. `FINDR_QA_FAMILY=xfp` or `twinflex` narrows an exploratory run and cannot generate final evidence.

The manual API is intercepted with original checked PDF bytes. Set `FINDR_QA_PDF` to the retained Gent PDF, `FINDR_XFP_PDF` to the XFP32 DFU2200510 Rev2 PDF, and `FINDR_TWINFLEX_PDF` to the TWINFLEXpro² 26-0959 Rev18 PDF when rerunning outside this workspace. The two new PDF hashes must match their audited source records; a placeholder PDF is rejected. Interception is removed before network-disabled reloads and saved-PDF reader checks. This tests FINDR storage and rendering; publisher retrieval and physical-panel behaviour are separate evidence.

The retained schedule is generated by the same committed 0.23 parser and validated through its import-store preparation function. It includes the original CSV headers, mapping, source strings and filename/hash. Its parser hash is recorded separately. Final acceptance also performs an actual network-disabled `L1 D37` lookup and opens the retained programmed location; it does not merely compare stored JSON.
